title: Setting up a game
goal: Get both sides of the table ready, step by step.

steps.html:
Before the first turn, each player does this, in order:

  1. Shuffle your 50-card deck and put it face down.
  2. Put your Leader face up in front of you.
  3. Put your 10 DON!! cards to the side. This is your DON!! deck.
  4. Play rock-paper-scissors. The winner chooses to go first or second.

Next, the opening hand:

  1. Draw 5 cards.
  2. If you don't like them, you may do one Mulligan: shuffle all 5 back and draw 5 new cards. The player going first decides first. You must keep the second hand.

Last, your Life:

  1. Take cards from the top of your deck equal to your Leader's Life number and place them face down as your Life. Don't look at them.

Now the first player starts their turn.
Going first or second? Going first lets you set up sooner, but on your very first turn you don't draw a card and you only get 1 DON!!. Many players still choose to go first.

quiz.q: How many cards are in your opening hand?
What do you do with your Life cards?
choices: Look at them, then place them face up
Place them face down without looking
quiz.why: Life cards go face down, unseen, from the top of your deck.

quiz.q: How many times can you mulligan (redraw) your opening hand?
choices: As many times as you want
quiz.why: You get one redraw, and you must keep the new hand.
